'''501400272204364191972''' was the identification code of a [[G-59 Cannibalizer]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] that was used during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Tilnes">{{LivingForce|Broken Orbits: Tilnes Rising}}</ref>

==History==
The Cannibalizer was used by the [[Thaereian military]]. It was once flown by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Delas Fotrin]] on a routine patrol near the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tilnes]]. However, it encountered an atmospheric disturbance, so Fotrin was forced to crash-land the Cannibalizer. It punctuated the crust and fell until it landed in a mineshaft that was located deep beneath the surface. Fotras recorded a short [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] message and then [[Death/Legends|died]] soon afterwards. The starfighter, and Fotrin's body, were discovered about ten years later, by the [[Heroes of Cularin]].<ref name="Tilnes" />
